title: Review (Supported): on fresh seed 5 pcell-mwall-b42 forms 30 bounded walled cells from noise that divide to generation 4, and intrinsic deaths fall at the 0.5th yield percentile (marker 54th) while splits fall at the 86th (marker 53rd)
summary: labkit run of world.py on seed 5 (t=100000) and c14's particle genealogy on the same seed. From an unstructured start (sheet t=0) 17-30 round cells form and stay bounded (largest cell median 8%, max 13% of in-cell particles). M wall material is membrane-like (rim/core 4.24, rim/out 18.2; 152/157 individuals) and the L link layer passes too (1.57). labkit: 17 persistent splits, generation 4, 1 merge; genealogy: 17 persistent splits, generation 4, 0 merges, 17 deaths, 0 conversions. Selection against the identical-event inert marker carried on the same particles: deaths at mean percentile 0.005 for yield vs 0.54 for the marker, splits at 0.86 vs 0.53; cells born below the median yield never split (0/6, death share 0.67) while high-born cells split 0.34 and die 0.06 (marker: 0.21/0.37 and 0.11/0.21); particle-weighted mean yield 1.00 -> 1.15 while the marker ends at 0.99.

observations.B: rerun/seed5/FACTS.md: M rim/core 4.24, rim/out 18.2, 152/157 membrane-like; L link 1.57
observations.D: rerun/seed5/FACTS.md: 17 persistent splits, generation 4, 1 merge; genealogy 17 splits, generation 4, 0 merges
observations.H: genealogy/readouts_s5.txt: death percentile 0.005 (yield) vs 0.54 (marker), split percentile 0.86 vs 0.53, low-born cells 0/6 split; mean yield 1.15 vs marker 0.99 (selfig_s5.png)

verdicts.limitation: One fresh seed. M is passive here (the claim says so); I did not rerun the bm=0 source ablation. Few dying cells have a recorded birth (6 with minlife 20), so the birth-rank fate split rests on small numbers; the death and split percentiles use all 17 deaths and 17 splits.
